mapper.select: SELECT v.agent_version_id AS version_id, v.version_no, v.status, v.revision, v.published_at, v.last_update_time, (a.current_version_id = v.agent_version_id) AS current FROM squad_chat.sq_agent_version v JOIN squad_chat.sq_agent a ON a.agent_id = v.agent_id WHERE v.agent_id = #{agentId} ORDER BY v.version_no DESC
mapper.sql: SELECT tv.tool_version_id, t.tool_id, t.tool_code, t.tool_name, t.tool_type, t.status AS tool_status, tv.exposed_name, tv.description, tv.version_no, tv.status AS version_status, ( SELECT MAX(latest.version_no) FROM squad_chat.sq_tool_version latest WHERE latest.tool_id = t.tool_id AND latest.status = 'PUBLISHED' ) AS latest_version_no, mv.mcp_server_id, ( tv.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND t.status = 'ENABLED' AND ( tv.mcp_server_version_id IS NULL OR (mv.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND m.status = 'ENABLED') ) ) AS usable FROM squad_chat.sq_tool_version tv JOIN squad_chat.sq_tool t ON t.tool_id = tv.tool_id LEFT JOIN squad_chat.sq_mcp_server_version mv ON mv.mcp_server_version_id = tv.mcp_server_version_id LEFT JOIN squad_chat.sq_mcp_server m ON m.mcp_server_id = mv.mcp_server_id
mapper.select: JOIN squad_chat.sq_agent_version_tool binding ON binding.tool_version_id = tv.tool_version_id WHERE binding.agent_version_id = #{agentVersionId} ORDER BY binding.id
mapper.sql: SELECT child.agent_version_id AS subagent_version_id, a.agent_id AS subagent_id, a.agent_code AS subagent_code, a.agent_name AS subagent_name, a.agent_type AS subagent_type, a.status AS subagent_status, child.description, child.version_no, child.status AS version_status, current_version.version_no AS current_version_no, ( child.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND a.status = 'ENABLED' AND a.agent_type = 'SUB_AGENT' ) AS usable FROM squad_chat.sq_agent_version child JOIN squad_chat.sq_agent a ON a.agent_id = child.agent_id LEFT JOIN squad_chat.sq_agent_version current_version ON current_version.agent_version_id = a.current_version_id

SELECT v.agent_version_id AS subagent_version_id, a.agent_id, a.agent_code, a.agent_name, v.description, v.version_no, (a.current_version_id = v.agent_version_id) AS current FROM squad_chat.sq_agent_version v JOIN squad_chat.sq_agent a ON a.agent_id = v.agent_id WHERE v.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND a.status = 'ENABLED' AND a.agent_type = 'SUB_AGENT' ORDER BY a.agent_code, v.version_no DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE squad_chat.sq_agent_version SET description = #{description}, system_prompt = #{systemPrompt}, max_iters = #{maxIters}, revision = revision + 1, last_updater_id = #{lastUpdaterId}, last_update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND agent_version_id = #{agentVersionId} AND status = 'DRAFT' AND revision = #{revision}
